notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.
This starter is generic: rename every item to the real part ('bin body', 'lid', 'wheel pair') and split the body into the pieces the design has.
